content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Clarksville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and documented project hours meet PMI's criteria before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Attend sessions on your schedule, interact with active certified practitioners, and build the foundation required to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay the exam fee and wait for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to reinforce concepts and build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a testing center, then sit for the comprehensive PMP assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle by attending training, presenting, or publishing. Renew your credential on schedule to keep it active and demonstrate ongoing commitment to project-management excellence.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
